title: Co-optimizing the Smart Grid and Electric Public Transit Bus System
abstract: arXiv:2012.08087v4 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As climate change provides impetus for investing in smart cities, with electrified public transit systems, we consider electric public transportation buses in an urban area, which play a role in the power system operations in addition to their typical function of serving public transit demand. Our model considers a social planner, such that the transit authority and the operator of the electricity system co-optimize the power system to minimize the total operational cost of the grid, while satisfying additional transportation constraints on buses. We provide deterministic and stochastic formulations to co-optimize the system. Each stochastic formulation provides a different set of recourse actions to manage the variable renewable energy uncertainty: ramping up/down the conventional generators, or charging/discharging of the transit fleet. We demonstrate the capabilities of the model and the benefit obtained via a coordinated strategy.

translated_title: 智能电网与电动公共交通巴士系统的协同优化
translated_abstract: 随着气候变化推动对配备电气化公共交通系统的智慧城市的投资，我们考虑了城市地区的电动公共交通巴士，除了其服务公共交通需求的典型功能外，它们还在电力系统运行中发挥作用。我们的模型引入了一个社会规划者的角色，使交通管理部门与电力系统运营商协同优化电力系统，以最小化电网的总运营成本，同时满足巴士方面的额外交通约束。我们提供了确定性模型和随机性模型来实现系统协同优化。每种随机模型提供了一组不同的补救措施来应对可变可再生能源的不确定性：上调或下调传统发电机的出力，或对公交车队进行充放电。我们展示了该模型的能力以及通过协调策略所获得的效益。
tldr: 该论文提出一个由社会规划者主导的协同优化框架，将电动公共交通巴士同时作为交通载具和电网灵活性资源，通过确定性与随机性优化模型在可再生能源不确定性下最小化电网总运营成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a social-planner co-optimization framework that treats electric public transit buses as both transit vehicles and grid flexibility resources, using deterministic and stochastic models to minimize total grid operational cost under renewable energy uncertainty.
